dispositions.topic_text: Ownership of source-supplied datetime normalization to naive UTC
dispositions.what: snapshot_import, expense_intake, photo_management and service_identity notes: a supplied offset-aware time (approved_at, published_at, confirmed_at, photo_date, a supplied service-credential expires_at) is converted to UTC, keeping its instant, before the offset is dropped; the module that accepts the input does it. Principle by operating profile (one process, SQLite, simplicity and predictability): one stored meaning per timestamp, the instant.
